feature: Intelligence Agency upgrade indicator source audit
scope: Read-only diagnosis of user screenshot and source files; no game files changed.

screenshot.limits: User-provided crop. It shows the repeated green indicator symptom but not the complete agency screen, scale, selected upgrade state or queue.

finding.severity: P2 visual defect; source correction applied
finding.confidence: High for source mismatch; strong but not runtime-confirmed attribution to the screenshot symptom.
finding.summary: Fixed the frame declaration from 2 to 3, matching the installed 1.19.4 native sprite sheet. The source mismatch is resolved; the screenshot symptom remains unverified in the live UI.
finding.recommendation: The current frame metadata is repaired. Run tools/md_update_203/fix_agency_repetition_frames.py --repair after any future MD interface sync, then run it with --check.

anchors.detail: The overridden sprite name, base-game texture path and incorrect noOfFrames=2.
Installed game 1.19.4 native declaration uses noOfFrames=3.
The upgrade card places repeated level indicators in the repetitions_icons box at x=37, y=63, using 100x20 and spacing 2.
Each repeated icon slot is 11x21; its child uses GFX_agency_upgrade_repetition_icon at scale 0.7 with frame=1.
Industrial Espionage is upgrade_blueprint_stealing with three level blocks.

comparison.project_gui_vs_main_md: Identical except the project marker comment at file start.
comparison.blueprint_upgrade_vs_main_md: The complete upgrade_blueprint_stealing definition is identical.
comparison.project_gfx_vs_main_md: The upstream file is unchanged. The project copy now differs from the main MD donor only by the file-start integration note, the native three-frame value, and its scoped inline project marker.
comparison.game_gui: The upgrade_entry, repetitions_icons and queue_badge geometry is the native layout. Project and MD donor preserve it. The game GUI differs at the upgrade cancel-tooltip key, but not at these indicator coordinates.

progress.detail: upgrade_progressbar is inside agency_agents at screen-window y=280 plus local y=50. There is no progressbar child inside upgrade_entry. The green item under the card title is therefore not supplied by the agency_agents operation progressbar.

native_queue.detail: queue_badge is a separate hidden 30x30 child at x=105,y=-18 with clipping=no and a numbered GFX_generic_circle_background. Its fields and layout agree with the native 1.19.4 GUI; it does not drive the repeated green level dots.

assets.texture_layout: Three horizontal 32x32 status icons: dark outline, green fill, amber fill. The project has no overriding copy of this DDS.
assets.industrial_espionage_icon: gfx/interface/operatives/icons/agency_steal_blueprints.dds, 68x68; unchanged in project and game source.
assets.cost_tile: gfx/interface/tiles/tiled_decisions_bg_small.dds, 48x48; the cornered tile is 40x50 with 8px borders.

upgrade_definition.project_vs_md_donor: Complete definition is identical; no France-specific cost, queue or progress definition is present.

conclusion: The project sprite metadata is corrected and an idempotent post-sync owner prevents a future two-frame declaration from passing check mode. GUI geometry, queue fields, costs, upgrade definitions and country setup remain unchanged. Live rendering remains unverified.
validation_limits: Read-only source and image inspection only. Computer-use access was denied by the task and was not retried or bypassed.
No in-game UI reproduction, cache reload or gameplay cost/progress test was performed.

implementation.change: Added a scoped file-start integration marker and changed only GFX_agency_upgrade_repetition_icon noOfFrames from 2 to 3 with an inline project marker. No other sprite declarations changed.

repair_owner.behavior: Idempotent, country-independent post-sync repair and strict validator. The default is check-only. The native DDS dimensions and GUI reference/geometry are validated before any repair.

current_repair_runs.repair: PASS, idempotent no-op after applied patch
current_repair_runs.gui_reference_scan: all project interface GUI files contain exactly one reference

validation.game_ui_validation: Not performed. Computer-use access remained unavailable; only the provided cropped screenshot and source were inspected.
